newsitem.title: DENMARK: Tele Danmark says staff end stoppages.
newsitem.headline: Tele Danmark says staff end stoppages.

text.p: Danish telecoms group Tele Danmark said on Friday that most of the thousands of employees involved in protest action against staff cuts had agreed to return to work and services should be back to normal by about 1700 GMT.
A Tele Danmark statement said that at a meeting earlier union officials advised their members to go back on the job.
"This has now happened," the statement said.
On Wednesday Tele Danmark announced a net staff reduction of 2,000 of its 16,500 staff by mid-1998, triggering protest strikes and works meetings.
The company had warned on Thursday that faults might go unrepaired as many of the strikers were technicians. --Joern Nurkka, Copenhagen newsroom +45 33969655
